name: Ofterdingen (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided yellow over blue, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Ofterdingen (a yellow sheaf with a flail on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Ofterdingen; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Ofterdingen arms — sheaf and flail on blue
